code.summary: Arwing wing platform. Off at init; while patrolling and is_arwing_line_active && |arwing_root.translate.z| < 200 (grSectorArwingDecideZNear) the code sets status On and mpCollisionSetYakumonoPosID(1, {arwing_root.x + arwing_target_x, arwing_root.y + pilot_dobj.y, 0}). arwing_root = map_dobjs[0] animated by the chosen SectorDesc path (TraI spline), pilot_dobj = map_dobjs[1] animated by a random pilot anim. Turned Off when the flight ends.

hazards_summary.name: Arwing fly-by with wing platform + lasers
functions: sources/ssb-decomp-re/src/gr/grcommon/grsector.c: grSectorProcUpdate, grSectorArwingUpdateWait, grSectorArwingUpdatePatrol, grSectorArwingUpdateCollisions, func_ovl2_80107958 (lasers), grSectorArwingWeaponLaser2DMakeWeapon, grSectorArwingWeaponLaser3DMakeWeapon, grSectorInitAll
hazards_summary.summary: Arwing appears after 600 ticks (then every rand(1140)+960 ticks), flies one of 8 spline paths, its wing is collision yakumono 1 while |z|<200 and the pilot anim keeps the line active. Close passes (patterns 0-4) fire 2D lasers (vel_air.x = -230) in pairs; far passes fire 3D lasers at a random fighter (speed 230) from a point 666 units ahead of the nose.

constants.laser_target_box (2D): fighter.x < arwing.x and arwing.y-500 < fighter.y < arwing.y+300

arwing.note: Collision yakumono 1 = Arwing wing. Position = (path.x + arwing_target_x, path.y + pilot.translate.y). path = map_dobjs[0] driven by SectorDesc anim (TraI spline via syInterpCubic, baked here); pilot = map_dobjs[1] (translate reset to 0 before each flight) driven by a random pilot anim. Model DObjDesc: FoxSpecial3 (file 161) EntryArwing @0x2C30.

pilot_choice_tables.rule: when the pilot wait reaches 0: pilot = dGRSectorArwingPilotIDs[t[0] + syUtilsRandIntRange(t[1])] with t = dGRSectorArwingPilotWaitTimers[pilot_prev]; pilot 0 = no pilot anim. After a pilot anim ends: wait 120.

arwing.flight_choice: normal: pattern = syUtilsRandIntRange(5) (0..4) while arwing_type_cycle != 0 (starts at 3, decremented); then pattern = syUtilsRandIntRange(3) + 5 (5..7) and cycle reset to 3 (grSectorArwingUpdateWait)
